answer: No claim clears until the yarrow audit walks the ridge. Each identity stakes 600,000 POA at one ridge vertex at registration, and the audit records every vertex mark once per epoch. Two claims sharing a vertex belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both bonds pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 200,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 800,000 POA, and five fakes cost 4,000,000 POA before any payout clears.
